'''Clue scroll (elite)''' is an [[anagram clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (elite)|elite]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 78
|text = The anagram reveals who to speak to:<br><br>MACHETE CLAM
|notes = Speak to [[Cam the Camel]] at the gates of [[Emir's Arena]] (no [[Camulet]] required) or [[Bank Camel|Cam the Camel]] in the entrance to the [[Tombs of Amascut]] (requires a [[Camulet]] and to have already learned her name)
The clue requires completion of a [[challenge scroll]]:

Question: ''How many items can carry water in Gielinor?''

Answer: '''6'''
|map = {{Map|3300,3231|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Changes==

{{Subject changes

|change = The Bank Camel's name will also now be a valid answer to the MACHETE CLAM Elite anagram clue once you've learned it.

==Trivia==
* As of [[2024]], there are actually 9 items that can carry water - [[bowl]]s, [[bucket]]s, [[Empty cup|cups]], [[fishbowl]]s, [[jug]]s, [[vial]]s, [[watering can]]s, [[kettle]]s, and [[waterskin]]s. This number is increased to 11 if counting the [[Empty vial|special vial]] used in [[Lunar Diplomacy]] and the [[Empty gourd vial|gourd vials]] used in the [[Chambers of Xeric]] separately from normal vials.
